signals_info.description: Whether the AEB system is issuing or maintaining a braking request.

time_info.description: Bounded AEB braking-response window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 0.5 seconds, the AEB braking request shall be active.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 0.5 秒内，AEB 制动请求应至少有一个时刻处于生效状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The AEB braking request shall be active within 0.5 seconds.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: AEB 制动请求应在 0.5 秒内生效。
